item.title: Version 2.3
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.3

  • Check for Updates. iPod Drop now updates itself. It checks once a day, or choose iPod Drop › Check for Updates…
  • Fix Info for your whole library. A new Fix Info toolbar button and File › Fix Info for All Songs… (⇧⌘I) look up missing titles, artists, albums, genres, years, track numbers and cover art. Fill in only what's missing or replace everything; songs from the same album are matched together, with time left and a Stop button.
  • Interrupted saves can be recovered. If saving to the iPod was cut off, iPod Drop now offers Restore Previous Library or Keep Current Contents instead of getting stuck on "Opening iPod…".
  • Ejecting is more reliable. If macOS is briefly using the iPod, Eject retries for a few seconds and then says plainly which app is holding it.
  • Clearer errors. A harmless timezone note no longer hides the real reason a save failed, and error reports include the previous session's log.
